name: OVOBench
intro: OVO-Bench 是面向在线长视频理解的综合基准，统一评测后向追溯、实时视觉感知和前向主动响应三种在线模式。论文版包含644个独立视频、12类任务和2,814条问答/元标注。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Tsinghua University, Beihang University, Communication University of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, SenseTime Research, Shanghai Innovation Institute
build_method: 源视频整理, 人机协同时间戳与问答标注, 干扰项设计与人工复核
task_type: 在线视频理解, 多项选择问答, 时机感知响应
eval_feature: 后向追溯, 实时视觉感知, 前向主动响应
scale: 论文版644个独立视频, 2,814条问答/元标注, 12类任务
task_type_en: Online Video Understanding, Multiple-choice QA, Timing-aware Response
build_method_en: Source-video Curation, Human-AI Timestamp and QA Annotation, Distractor Design and Human Review
eval_feature_en: Backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding
intro_en: OVO-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for online long-video understanding that jointly evaluates backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding. The paper release contains 644 unique videos, 12 tasks, and 2,814 QA/meta-annotations.
scale_en: Paper release: 644 unique videos, 2,814 QA/meta-annotations, 12 tasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.05510 and the official JoeLeelyf/OVO-Bench repository. The diagrams preserve the three online modes and 12 tasks; curated public datasets and self-crawled YouTube videos across seven domains; validation/test-only leakage control; precise existing labels, Gemini-1.5 coarse timestamps, and volunteer meta-annotation; human timestamp refinement; GPT-4o-assisted candidate generation from short clips; human-proposed hard cases; visually grounded and rule-based distractors; manual review and option shuffling; start-to-query multiple-choice evaluation for backward and real-time tasks; dense timeline queries for forward response timing; task-specific scoring with GPT-4o judging for SSR and CRR; and the paper release of 644 unique videos and 2,814 QA/meta-annotations. Later repository query-count revisions are not substituted for the paper release.
